2610.10066.title: From Pixel to Coding: Evaluating the Figure Reproduction Capabilities of MLLMs
2610.10066.paper_summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in both visual understanding and code generation. However, existing benchmarks typically evaluate these two modalities in isolation, lacking a dedicated assessment of their unification, i.e., how a model can perceive complex visual structures and synthesize them into precise, executable code. Moreover, current visual code generation benchmarks often rely on simplified layouts within single programming environments, falling short of evaluating true unified multimodal reasoning. To bridge this gap, we propose FigCodeBench, a comprehensive framework for rigorously evaluating MLLMs on figure reproduction, integrating multimodal comprehension and generation. We first design a systematic dataset construction pipeline, resulting in a total of 6,194 instances that cover 7 functional categories and 4 types of programming languages. We further categorize figure reproduction into three tiers with visual and code complexity modeling, specifically targeting complex structural reasoning, varying aspect ratios, and dense geometric constraints. We introduce a multi-dimensional evaluation protocol, encompassing visual fidelity and syntactic isomorphism, that aligns highly with the Mean Machine Opinion Score (MMOS) and human preferences. Based on our framework, we conducted extensive experiments on 24 widely used proprietary and open-source MLLMs (e.g., Gemini 3.1 Pro, GPT-5.4, and Kimi-K2.5), where we observed a universal, non-linear performance cliff across different programming languages and difficulty scenarios for all models, and gained several insights, such as the significant metric decline in rigid declarative languages.
2610.10066.paper_summary_zh: 多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）在視覺理解和代碼生成方面展現了令人印象深刻的能力。<lb/>然而，現有的基準通常孤立地評估這兩種模態，缺乏對其統一性的專門評估，即模型如何感知複雜的視覺結構並將其合成為精確的可執行代碼。<lb/>此外，目前的視覺代碼生成基準往往依賴於單一編程環境中的簡化佈局，未能真正評估統一的多模態推理。<lb/>為了填補這一空白，我們提出了FigCodeBench，一個全面的框架，用於嚴格評估MLLMs在圖形再現方面的表現，整合多模態理解和生成。<lb/>我們首先設計了一個系統的數據集構建流程，最終產生了總共6,194個實例，涵蓋7個功能類別和4種編程語言類型。<lb/>我們進一步將圖形再現分為三個層級，並進行視覺和代碼複雜性建模，特別針對複雜的結構推理、不同的長寬比和密集的幾何約束。<lb/>我們引入了一個多維評估協議，涵蓋視覺真實性和語法同構性，與平均機器意見分數（MMOS）和人類偏好高度一致。<lb/>基於我們的框架，我們對24個廣泛使用的專有和開源MLLMs（例如，Gemini 3.1 Pro、GPT-5.4和Kimi-K2.5）進行了廣泛的實驗，觀察到所有模型在不同編程語言和難度情境下的普遍非線性性能懸崖，並獲得了幾個見解，例如在剛性聲明性語言中的顯著指標下降。
